extracted.name: Easy Roasted Zucchini
extracted.description: Tender, golden roasted zucchini seasoned with garlic, herbs, Parmesan cheese, and crunchy bread crumbs makes a delicious summer side dish.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Gather the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Place zucchini into a nonstick baking dish and drizzle oil over top. Add bread crumbs, Parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper; mix until well combined.
Bake in the preheated oven, stirring every 10 to 15 minutes, until zucchini is tender and cheese is melted, about 40 minutes.
